title: BEYOND SEEING: EVALUATING MULTIMODAL LLMS ON TOOL-ENABLED IMAGE PERCEPTION, TRANSFORMATION, AND REASONING
reasoning: The paper is a technical study introducing a new benchmark (VISUALTOOLBENCH) to evaluate the ability of Multimodal Large Language Models to use vision tools for image manipulation and reasoning.
